data.title:
5 Local SEO basics to
*get found locally*
data.sub: Swipe to see if you're visible →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Claim your *Google Business* Profile
data.body: This is the most important step for showing up on Google Maps. It tells customers where you are and what you do.
data.fix: Fix: Verify your business on Google Business Profile today.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Keep your *NAP* consistent
data.body: NAP stands for Name, Address, and Phone number. If these differ across the web, Google gets confused and won't show your site.
data.fix: Fix: Ensure your contact info matches exactly on every social profile.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Get *more reviews*
data.body: Local customers trust other customers. A steady stream of positive feedback helps you outrank your competitors in your city.
data.fix: Fix: Send a text link to three happy clients today.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Use *local keywords* on-site
data.body: Mention your city and service area on your homepage. It helps Google connect your site to people nearby.
data.fix: Fix: Add your city name to your website’s main headline.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Ensure your site is *mobile-friendly*
data.body: Most local searches happen on phones while on the go. If your site is hard to use, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Open your site on your phone to test the buttons.
